articles.title: Hankook Tire Opens New Onsite Health Clinic for Employees and Their Families at Tennessee Plant
articles.mainIdea: Hankook Tire Opens New Onsite Health Clinic for Employees and Their Families at Tennessee Plant
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Hankook Tire Opens New Onsite Health Clinic for Employees and Their Families at Tennessee Plant. Hankook Tire today announced the opening of the Hankook Tire Clinic Powered by Evernorth, a new onsite health center at its Clarksville, Tenn. manufacturing plant that will provide convenient, affordable care to employees and their families.
